# Concerning the Highest Good, etc.

<margin>Job 38:5 <note>The original Latin marginalia reads "Ioh. 38. 5," likely a typographical error for Job, where this verse appears.</note></margin>
He himself says in this series of discourse: *Who disposed the measure of the earth, upon what are its bases fixed, or who laid its cornerstone, etc.?* From this, he argues that the **cornerstone** is the foundation, life, and existence of the entire Earth, which exists everywhere within its mass no differently than the human soul is said to exist in the whole and in every individual part of its body. But the **cornerstone is Christ**, and Christ is the true light and the Savior of the world; would it then be absurd to say with the Prophet, *Let the earth be opened and bring forth a Savior,* <note>Isaiah 45:8</note> since we have seen that the Savior is in the earth? Thus also says **Ecclesiasticus**, *Medicine is extracted from the earth, and a wise man will not abhor it.* And **Solomon** says, *not by herb or ointment, but by your word you healed them,* <note>Wisdom of Solomon 16:12</note> and again he says:
<margin>Proverbs 2:4</margin>
*If you seek Wisdom like money, and dig for it like treasure:* it is therefore the task of the **Chemical men** <note>original: *viri Chymici*, referring to alchemists</note> to seek the most suitable earth, or the **Stone of Jacob**, which was the house of God, and to knock with justice and proper measure: so that the "just one" may arise from there, no differently than that same divinity in the dead Christ, buried in the rock (not previously used), by means of which He rose again from death to life.

Let this comparison of ours not trouble **Marinus** <note>Marin Mersenne, Fludd's intellectual opponent</note>, because the universal Christ, although He has many members and many mansions, is nonetheless only one, and that indivisible in His substance, which fills all things. Why, therefore, should it be so absurd for true Alchemists to speak (with Isaiah) of a new birth of the Savior or of Wisdom, or of the earth or rock in which that divine treasure is hidden and, as it were, buried, and of its incarnation? For He can convert Himself into human nature through the true Sacrament or the **Lord's Supper**, refreshing the <term>Microcosmic sun</term> <note>The divine spark or "inner sun" within the human being, the "little world."</note> with that same Spiritual sun lurking everywhere in the <term>Macrocosm</term> <note>The "great world" or the universe at large.</note>, so that we might thus be regenerated and recover a sound mind in a sound body. Are we not called the brothers of Christ? Indeed, this is even known among the Heathens themselves, for **Zoroaster** (whom Marinus falsely esteemed as an evil magician) says:
> You must ascend to the light itself, and to the rays of the Father, from whence a soul was sent to you, clothed in much intellect.
And **Trismegistus** says:
> You must ascend above the heavens and be far removed from the choirs of Demons.
And **Pythagoras** says:
> If you, leaving the body, pass into the free ether, you will be an immortal God.
And again **Trismegistus**:
> Man is a great miracle, a living creature to be adored and honored, for he passes into the nature of God and is as if he were God.
But so that this appears not at all absurd to readers, we also have this same point confirmed by Holy Scripture, where we read that *he who adheres to God shall become one Spirit with him* <note>1 Corinthians 6:17</note>. And elsewhere: *At last we shall be transformed into the same image,* and also in many other places. Here, therefore, we think it should be understood in passing: that where the aforesaid Philosophers speak of the ascent to the Father of light and above the heavens, they do not mean the common heavens which will pass away and perish on the Day of Judgment. Rather, they mean those which immediately receive that divine Wisdom as a vehicle, which we also have here on earth, according to that axiom: *Truth has sprung from the midst of the earth.* And elsewhere: *Who can tell his generation, for his life is taken from the earth,* as if he had said, "*let the earth be opened and bring forth a Savior.*" Hence, Christ says: *You who are earthly and ignorant of heavenly things, how will you perceive them?* Therefore, <term>sublimation</term> <note>In alchemy, the process of heating a substance until it turns to vapor and then solidifies again; here used metaphorically for spiritual elevation.</note> from earth to heaven is like one who is said to be "sublimed" from the lowest rank to that of a Bishop.

In this way, Christ was exalted from a corporeal and mortal state to a Spiritual and incorruptible one, while nonetheless remaining upon the earth. But to the matter at hand. You see, therefore, that just as Jehovah made the foundation of the earth, so He Himself is present there, and there He is to be found by the Wise and the elect. Wisdom says: *From the mouth of the Most High I came forth,*
<margin>Ecclesiasticus 3 <note>Actually Ecclesiasticus 24:5</note></margin>
*I alone compassed the circuit of the heavens, and I walked in the depth of the abyss.* And **David** says: *Jehovah is that cornerstone, and it is marvelous in our eyes.* This, therefore, is He who is accustomed to uplift and restore the sick in both soul and body, by whose virtue one shall be sublimated from earth to heaven, from a diseased spirit into the ethereal, and above the sphere of wicked demons. Thus, as it is the duty of common Theologians...

### Treatise

...to teach only that which they do not know how to do; in contrast, the true and occult **Alchemists** <note>original: *veri Chymici & occulti*</note> (so called because they are possessors of the mystic Wisdom which is hidden, as the Apostle testifies) are able both to practice and to speculate. But even now, I hear Marinus <note>Marin Mersenne (1588–1648), a French philosopher and mathematician who was a fierce critic of Fludd’s Hermetic and alchemical views.</note> muttering, and I perceive him smiling, saying:

"But where is that gold which those Alchemists promise with such great ostentation?" To whom we say, along with the true Alchemists: Our gold is not the gold of the common people <note>original: *aurum vulgi*</note>, but the **living gold** and the **Gold of God**. Does not the Holy Scripture also testify to this? <margin>Job 37:22 <note>The Latin text cites Job 37; verse 22 in the Vulgate refers to "golden splendor" coming from the North.</note></margin> "From the North," says Job, "golden light comes for God, who is terrible in praise," where by "golden light" he understands the living Gold of God—namely His shining **Word** or **Wisdom**—about which the Psalmist understands: <margin>Psalm 12:6</margin> "The word of Jehovah is pure, like silver refined and purified in an earthly crucible seven times." And this living gold is that "gold tried in the fire" to be bought from Christ, which the Holy Scripture mentions; which the Sages describe as a **fiery Spirit**, a glowing spark, an impassible grain, never dying, sublimating its own body, inhabiting all created things, sustaining and governing them—a pure gold that in the fire is always more glorious and pure, rejoicing without demonstration. Indeed, this is that golden Spirit which Solomon calls the brightness of divine light and the mirror of His goodness: <margin>Ecclesiasticus 1, 6; 1:5</margin> *which is that Wisdom whose root and source is the Word of God on high, in which is the beauty of life; God pours it out upon all His works, and upon all flesh according to His gift, and has provided it to those who love Him.* Wherefore it is also abundantly infused into the earth, which <margin>Psalm 104:24</margin> David also acknowledges with these words: *In Wisdom You have made all things; the earth is filled with Your possession.* By these things, therefore, you see that this gift is not only subject to use, but can also be touched and perceived in its action.

For what else, I ask you, was the substance of that draught taken by Esdras <note>Ezra, specifically referring to the vision in the apocryphal book 2 Esdras 14:38-40.</note> except that Spiritual, fiery, and living liquor gushing from that Catholic <note>Here "Catholic" means universal or all-encompassing.</note> rock, concerning which we read this written: *Behold, a full cup was reached to me. This was full like water, but its color was like fire: and I took it and drank, and when I had drunk, my heart was tormented (or filled) with understanding, and Wisdom grew in my breast, etc.* By this speech, he seems to find that cup of the charity of shining Wisdom most full of waves, with the liquor contained therein having been seen, touched, and tasted by him; by the power of which he was not only most filled with Wisdom, but was also sustained for a space of 40 days without other food or drink. In this same way or manner of sustenance, Elijah in the desert and Moses on the mountain were preserved from hunger and thirst for that space of time; and also Christ in the desert when he was tempted by the Devil. Christ seemed to prove most rightly to the Devil that such nourishment was the **Word** proceeding from the mouth of Jehovah, and not common bread. Inasmuch as it is also said in another place to be the "bread of angels," by which the Israelites were nourished in the desert for 40 years; and again it is said that the spiritual rock emitting living waters was Christ. <margin>Revelation 2</margin> What else is meant by that hidden manna, the tree of life in Paradise, that white stone, and that morning star mentioned in the Apocalypse? <margin>Wisdom 7</margin> Do they not intend by these things this one and only hidden and mystic Spirit, which although it is simple in itself, nevertheless used to appear in various forms to the elect, clothed in the diverse garments of nature? Whence it is called "manifold" by the Wise Man. Wherefore it appeared to the ancients in the form of the **Urim** and **Thummim** <note>Sacred objects used by Israelite priests for divination.</note>; to Elijah in the form of a thin breeze and the morning star; to Esdras in the form of a fiery draught; to Ezekiel in the form of burning coals which he devoured; to St. John in the form of a book, which he also devoured; in Christ in the form of a dove; to the Apostles in the form of tongues [of fire], and so in the others according to the divine will, and in the manner of one powerful and knocking. And St. John confesses this same thing in these words: <margin>1 John 1</margin> *That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon and our hands have handled, of the Word of life we announce to you, etc.*

By these words, he does not mean the fleshly Christ, inasmuch as he was not from the beginning. Furthermore, why would he say so many words about Christ as a man, since even the Jews themselves saw him?

<meta>This page continues Robert Fludd’s defense of "mystic Wisdom" against the criticisms of Marin Mersenne. Here, he elaborates on why this spiritual substance is superior to physical gold, drawing on the authority of alchemical masters like Basil Valentine and Artephius to explain the "animal stone"—the transformation of the human being into a glorified state.</meta>

-> ### Concerning the Sovereign Good, etc. <-

...heard and touched as well as Saint John? But if you ask why he then made mention of His voice, I respond that the elect were accustomed to receive responses from the **Urim and Thummim** <note>original: *Vrim & Thummim*; Hebrew terms from the breastplate of the High Priest, which Fludd interprets here as "Lights and Perfections."</note>, which words signify light or perfection, of the same kind as that holy **Wisdom**. Were not the Apostles also false, if the whole subject of their happiness was a mystic Wisdom, which was hidden and reserved for the elect? He does not speak of a carnal Christ, but of the Christ proceeding from the Father from the beginning, filling all things with His essence, by which the man Christ was the wealthiest of all mortal men.

But I know Mersenne <note>Marin Mersenne (1588–1648), the French polymath and Fludd's chief intellectual opponent.</note> will always persist and say: "Where are those golden mountains preached to the world by scoundrels of that sort?" To whom we respond: that physical gold is [nothing] in respect to [this] gold. And although riches also accompany the possessor of Wisdom (since, according to Solomon’s testimony, Wisdom holds riches in her left hand as much as health and long life in her right), nevertheless she encompasses far higher secrets, since she is that great sea from which all the streams of mysteries go forth, and into which they return again. Indeed, as Christ says, *he who has as much faith as a grain of mustard seed can move mountains and perform far greater things.* Therefore, so that Marinus <note>A dismissive Latinization of Mersenne's name.</note> may not hereafter vex or molest the true disciples of **Alchemy** with further cavils, I shall open to him especially the mystery of the **animal stone** <note>original: *lapidis animalis*; in alchemy, this refers to a "stone" or medicine derived from an animal or human source, often symbolizing the spiritualization of the human body.</note>, if he be not of a stiff neck and a deaf understanding. First, let him conceive that the Wise man reads one thing but understands another; then, let him acknowledge with **Brother Basil Valentine** <note>Basilius Valentinus, a legendary 15th-century alchemical author and supposed Benedictine monk.</note> that man is the most excellent of all creatures:

<margin>
Basil
Alchemy.
</margin>

> For, he says, although the animals of the earth are composed of flesh and blood just like man, and have a vivifying Spirit and breath implanted in them, they are nevertheless destitute of the **rational soul** with which man is endowed above all other animals. Therefore, when the beasts exchange life for death, it is entirely finished for them; but if man offers his life to his Creator through temporal death, the soul survives. And when he has been glorified, his soul, returning into a glorified body, will dwell there, so that body, soul, and Spirit are gathered together and are able to demonstrate their heavenly clarity, which can never be separated for all eternity. For this reason, man is known as a creature predestined by reason of his soul, since (even if he seems to die when viewed from the outside) he is to live forever: for death is the clarification of man. Now the Spirit can dwell in a certain body, but it does not follow from this that it will be fixed; although the body may agree with the Spirit, yet they may both be destitute of 그 strong bond which binds and confirms the body and Spirit, and protects and defends them against all dangers—namely, the most precious, noble, and **fixed soul**. And this is one of the greatest secrets, which it befits the Sage and the one devoting effort to inquiry to know.

But my conscience has not allowed me to pass this over in silence, but rather to reveal it to those who love the foundation of all Wisdom. Thus speaks Basil Valentine. Do you understand, Mersenne, the excellent teachings of this good Monk? Certainly, if you had been as great and of such a kind as he was, you would never have brought forth so many evils and falsehoods against **Alchemy**, **Kabbalah**, and true **Magic**. But to the purpose: from the words of Basil, it will be right to gather what that true and living **animal gold** is—that gold, I say, to be bought from Christ. You have, I say, set before your eyes the basis of the **animal stone**, about which the **Rosarius** <note>The *Rosarium Philosophorum* (The Rosary of the Philosophers), a famous 16th-century alchemical treatise.</note> says: *Would you believe that the stones which proceed from animals are more precious than the others?* And **Artephius** <note>A legendary 12th-century alchemist rumored to have lived for a thousand years.</note> seems to confirm this sense of Basil in these words:

> God is bound to His creatures through His **Word**, and separated from them insofar as He transcends them; for He did not create anything equal to Himself. But of His great benefits, this is the greatest: that He has bound our body with the most subtle of all elements, namely the **soul**, which sees hidden things clearly, provided that the power of the body does not dominate it. For the more the powers of the body are strengthened, the more the virtues of the soul must necessarily be weakened; and the more the body is weakened, the more the intuition of the soul itself is refined.

And for that reason, the master **Bolenius** <note>Likely referring to Belinus, a name associated with the *Emerald Tablet* in Arabic traditions.</note> said: *Place your light in a clear glass vessel, and note that all the Wisdom of this world is occupied with these three: namely, the binding of the corporal soul with the corporal soul, the **SPIRITUAL** soul with the corporal, and the **SPIRITUAL** with the **SPIRITUAL**.*

# Treatise

...but the binding of the bodily soul with the bodily is closer and easier than the spiritual with the spiritual. Thus he spoke. In this discourse, he explained the power of the **Wisdom** of the whole world and manifested the mystery of true **Alchemy** <note>original: *Chymiæ*; Fludd uses this term to refer to spiritual transformation rather than just laboratory chemistry.</note>. But these words of **Artephius** <note>Artephius (c. 1150) was a legendary alchemical author whose works were central to the Hermetic tradition.</note> seem to be excellently interpreted by another anonymous author thus: "Man knows and understands all secret things through the soul, provided it is not hindered by the body; for as much as the strength or power of the body is increased through the natural nourishment of food and drink, so much more is the understanding of the **Spirit** weakened and decreased." Hence says the wise **Belienus** <note>Belienus (or Balinus) is the medieval Latin name for Apollonius of Tyana, to whom the *Emerald Tablet* was often attributed.</note>: *Do you seek your light—that is, your soul? Seek it in a glass vessel—that is, in a body not too fattened—for thus can the intellect know and comprehend the secrets and wonders of God.* Thus he spoke. These things being rightly considered, it must be known with the highest consideration what kind of food the human body is (and that which increases its powers), and what kind that is which is accustomed to refresh the mind or soul; and consequently, if the soul is to be nourished more than the body, let us see what its nourishment is.

According to that old axiom of the Philosophers: *Like is nourished by its like.* But the soul is the most subtle of all created things; therefore its refreshment is from such a **Spirit**. So also we see that every vegetable is multiplied both in its formal power (through the soul's refreshment from its like) and its bodily dimension (through the constant application of subtle elements). But the soul is said to be a certain subtle fiery essence, which is the most effective power of the luminous form. To which nothing, however contrary, can resist. Therefore it is also necessary that she be refreshed by her like, gushing from the **fountain of all Wisdom**, by which she may overcome the bodily mass. Hence a certain learned man said excellently, that they draw nourishment by the **Spirit**, not by the mouth, who wish to live by the mind more than the [vital] spirit and to render their bodies subtle. For according to the sense of the sacred letters, it is heaven through heaven, not through earth; but it is permitted to know the powers of the latter through the former. For no one ascends to heaven except he who descended from heaven; let that light illuminate you first, for we cannot be better confirmed than through the power which is the supreme truth. Do you wish then, **Mersenne**, to forge the true **animal stone**? <note>original: *lapidem animalem*; the "animal stone" in alchemy refers to a medicine or transformation derived from the "anima" or soul, focusing on the spiritual perfection of the human being.</note> Seek the **cornerstone**, the base of all such transformation, within yourself; but first, I advise you to know yourself. Seek it, I say, within yourself: for you should know that **Jesus** dwells in your vile body, unless you wish to be considered a castaway. But **Jesus** is the **Word**, and that **Spiritual rock** <note>original: *petra illa Spiritualis*; a reference to 1 Corinthians 10:4.</note>, which I would not wish you to reject with the false builders, as the impostors do. Draw forth the power and act of that cornerstone from yourself, so that afterward you may be able to do good and bless not only yourself but others; let your light be shut up no longer in darkness or a dark lantern, but be sent forth for the benefit of yourself and others, by which you may live worthily and truly. For in this way is forged that true **animal stone**, and in this way you will be transmuted into a true **Cephas** <note>Aramaic for "Rock" or "Stone," the name given to the Apostle Peter.</note> with the **Apostle Peter**; nor should you despise the true **Philosophers** teaching the way, and pronounce them scoundrels worthy of punishment, while they teach the true way of that transformation of yours. For **Morienus** <note>Morienus Romanus, a legendary 7th-century hermit and alchemist.</note> says: *It is in you, and it is extracted from you, O good king.* And **Geber** <note>The Latinized name of Jabir ibn Hayyan (c. 721–815), the "father of chemistry."</note> teaches that one cannot arrive at the perfection of true **Alchemy** who has not known its principles in himself. Therefore I would have you know that whatever the Alchemists wrote, they wrote secretly and in a mystic manner, and yet the marrow of truth is hidden under the shadow of their writings, so that he who desires to wisely grasp the alchemical sense reads one thing and understands another—although in some places they may touch upon the mystery succinctly, and as if with a word. But you, according to the words of the aforesaid and the intention of the scriptures: *let your light so shine before men, that they may glorify our Father who is in heaven.* Let us come therefore to the practice.

*Be transmuted,* says **Dorn** <note>original: *Darnæus*; Gerard Dorn (c. 1530–1584), a prominent Belgian Paracelsian alchemist.</note>, *be transmuted from dead stones into living Philosophical stones.* The Apostle teaches us the way of such transmutation...

### On the Highest Good, etc.

...when he says:
> "Let the same mind be in you, which was in Jesus" <note>original: *Eadem mens sit in vobis, quæ est in Jesu*; Philippians 2:5.</note>

He explains this mind in the following words, namely:
> "though he was in the form of God, he did not think it robbery to be equal to God." <note>Philippians 2:6.</note>

But so that we can achieve this through **chemical steps**, it is necessary that we reveal the meaning of the **wise alchemists** with a slightly more accurate gaze, so that you may see that the **Sages** wrote one thing but understood another. Are you imperfect? Long for the required perfection. Are you foul and unclean? Purge yourself with tears, sublime <note>To "sublime" is an alchemical process of heating a substance so it turns to vapor and then purifies; here it refers to elevating the character.</note> yourself through morals and virtues, adorn yourself with the **sacramental graces**, and make the soul sublime and subtle for heavenly contemplations and conformed to **angelic spirits**. Do this so that the putrid and vile ash of the body can be vivified, whitened, and made incorruptible and impalpable through the resurrection of **Jesus Christ Our Lord** <note>original abbreviation: *I. C. D. N.*, standing for *Iesu Christi Domini Nostri*.</note>. But indeed, the **Apostle** <note>St. Paul</note> teaches us that **Jesus Christ Our Lord** is accustomed to appear to the chosen in this life and to provide all these things to them, where he says:
<margin>1 Corinthians 1</margin>
> "So that you lack nothing in any grace, as you wait for the revelation of Our Lord Jesus Christ, who will also confirm you until the end," etc.

By which it is declared that this appearance occurs in this life, just as in the second or future life there is no end.

We conclude, therefore, that **Jesus** is the **cornerstone** of the human temple. Through his exaltation, his temple will be exalted—not otherwise than in the time of **Solomon**, when, his prayers being finished, the glory of the Lord was said to have filled it. And so, from **Cephas** <note>The Aramaic name for Peter, meaning "Rock."</note> or **Aben** <note>The Hebrew word for "Stone."</note>—from the dead—pious men are made **living stones**. This happens through a **real transmutation** from the fallen state of **Adam** into the state of his innocence and perfection; that is, from the vile condition of **leperous lead** into the perfection of the **purest gold**. And this is mediated by that **living gold**, the mystic **Stone of the Philosophers**—I mean **Wisdom** and the divine emanation, which is the gift of God, and not otherwise.

Here, therefore, it must first be noticed that since it is given to man (thus exalted by divine grace and goodness) to know all secrets, the method of making **gold and silver** will undoubtedly be of the least importance among the other gifts. For if it is granted to those so exalted to know all gifts and secrets, it follows as a given that not even any particular detail remains hidden from them. But the **Apostle** says:
<margin>1 Corinthians 1</margin>
> "In everything you have been made rich in him, in every word and in all knowledge, just as the testimony was confirmed in you, so that you lack nothing in any grace," etc.

And **Solomon**:
<margin>Wisdom 7</margin>
> (Through Wisdom teaching me, I had knowledge of every thing, as much the hidden as the manifest.)

By these things one may see and observe whether those speeches were uttered with reason or judgment by **Mersenne** <note>Marin Mersenne (1588–1648), a French philosopher and mathematician who famously attacked Fludd and the Rosicrucian movement as heretical or fraudulent.</note>, who calls the true **Alchemists** "scoundrels and deluded ones" because they claim their words have a revelation in common with the mysteries of **Theology**. Yet the subject of all Scripture concerns the exercise of divine power for the sake of humanity, or the **resurrection of Christ**, which is nothing other than the most perfect sign that we can be regenerated in this life by the power of that **incarnate Word**, and rise from death to eternal life by means of that same **vivifying Spirit**. 

For if terms of this kind were not at all suited to a **divine Chemistry** of this sort, how poorly was it said by the Apostle: "Finally we shall be transformed into the same image." Indeed, concerning the purification of the heart, the rectification of the **Spirit**, the sublimation of the mind to God, the emission of light from darkness, the resurrection (both in this life and in the other), the resuscitation from mortal sleep, and infinite other terms belonging to **living Chemistry**, the **Holy Scriptures** make mention everywhere—of the corruptible and incorruptible body, of the change from the earthly state to the heavenly. Indeed, even through the **grain of wheat** itself, which **St. Paul** says must first die in the earth before it rises, he clearly argues that the actions of **Christ**, both in his life and passion as well as in his resurrection, can be expressed through the likeness of the smallest and most unworthy creatures—how much more through the divine voices of **true Alchemy** tending toward the exaltation of man? Since that **Spirit of Wisdom** is vivifying...

### Treatise

...of our Lord Jesus Christ.

He alone is the primary actor in every creature, by whom not only did Christ as man rise from death to life, but also all other Christians, led by His example, await this same thing with certain confidence. Indeed, we even see the lowliest plant (as is seen in a grain of wheat) rise and come to life again from corruption to generation through an admirable multiplication and increase by means of that **Universal Spirit** <note>original: *Spiritu vniuersali*. In Fludd's Hermetic philosophy, this is the divine life-force or "World Soul" that mediates between the Creator and the physical world.</note>.

# BOOK FOUR
### In which
## THE CAUSE OF THE BROTHERS OF THE ROSY CROSS, (WHOM that malevolent man also attacks through calumny and malice) is strenuously and manfully defended.

<image-desc>Ornamental woodcut initial Q depicting a man in a landscape setting.</image-desc>Since Friar Marin Mersenne’s <note>Marin Mersenne (1588–1648) was a French priest and mathematician who famously attacked Fludd, accusing him of heresy and "magic."</note> habit and delight, wandering far from charity, is to pursue men of every condition with insults and slanders, it cannot come to us unexpectedly if he attacks—through calumny and malice—those who are well-versed in true **Magic**, **Kabbalah**, and **Alchemy** <note>original: *Magia, Cabala, & Chymia*. In Fludd’s Hermetic philosophy, these are the three pillars of divine knowledge: Magic (natural wisdom), Kabbalah (spiritual wisdom), and Alchemy (the transformation of matter).</note>. For he even despises and condemns these sciences themselves—the chief pillars of Wisdom and inhabitants of the Palace of Wisdom—and attempts to banish them from the Christian crowd with the sound and blare of a trumpet, as it were. But let us look and inquire first whether there are indeed such men who inhabit the gift of Wisdom, before we make any mention of his rash judgment against them. In this inquiry of ours, we shall first bring forward the testimony of several recent authors, and then afterwards the testimony of the Sacred Scriptures. Among the more recent authors, Agrippa <note>Heinrich Cornelius Agrippa (1486–1535), an influential German polymath and occult writer.</note> mentioned such men in these words:

> *I confess,* he says, *there are even to this day some men heavy with Wisdom, distinguished in science, powerful in virtues and powers, upright in life and morals, and invincible in prudence—even well-prepared in age and strength so that they might be of great benefit to the state through their counsel and labor. But your courtiers despise these men as being far different from their own purpose; for these courtiers, malice stands for Wisdom, fraud and deceit for counsel, craftiness and cunning for science, deception and treachery for prudence; and in the place of religion, they possess superstition, etc.* 

<margin>Cardano, in *On Subtlety*</margin> Furthermore, Cardano <note>Girolamo Cardano (1501–1576), a famous Italian polymath. Fludd refers to a story where Cardano claimed supernatural beings appeared to his father.</note> also made a sufficiently clear mention of men of this kind, who on one occasion appeared to his father.

But even beyond the testimony of common authors, we also have those of the Sacred Scriptures, which confirm not only the existence of such men—who, as it were, build and inhabit that house of Wisdom—but also their successive continuation until the end of the world. By these scriptures, we are taught that there has been, is, or will be no age of the world in which there were not some who, having lived within the world and its darkness, possessed knowledge of the **holy light** <note>The "holy light" refers to divine illumination or the *Logos*, which Fludd believes allows certain chosen people to see the truth hidden from the rest of the world.</note>, by which prerogative they claimed for themselves the right to be numbered among the sons of God. Indeed, in every age and era, there have been some, though very few in number, who passed through the narrow gate, even though the greater part of men walked the wider and broader path. For we read that in every age of the Church, some are found to whom, if they are victorious, it is promised: <margin>a Rev. 2:7 b Rev. 2:17 c Rev. 2:26 & 8 d Rev. 1:5 e Rev. 3:12</margin> (a) *the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God;* (b) *or hidden manna, and a white stone;* (c) *or the morning star;* (d) *or white garments with which they may be clothed, and that gift by which their names are not blotted out from the book of life; (e) or they shall be pillars of the temple, and they shall have the new name of the Lamb, etc.* These words of the Evangelist are also understood to refer to men of this kind: <margin>John 1:12</margin> As many as received that true light, which enlightens every man coming into this world, to them He gave the power to become the sons of God and to inhabit the aforementioned house of Wisdom securely and firmly, built upon the mountain, according to that which was spoken by the Savior: <margin>Matt. 7:24 Luke 6:48</margin> *Everyone who hears these words of mine and does them shall be likened to a wise man who built his house upon a rock; and the rain fell, and the floods came, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it did not fall, for its foundation was upon a rock, etc.*

But you will say: why are these good inhabitants of that metaphorical house so hidden? How secret is their dwelling? Why have they not appeared to the world long before this time? If such virtue and power reside within them, why do they not reveal their secrets (as Mersenne wishes) for the benefit of the Commonwealth in which they live? To this objection I answer: they indeed grow rich with celestial riches, and yet to the world they are as if poor and unknown. This is not surprising, since those who are rich in Spirit despise the world and its pompous riches, according to that saying of the Evangelist: *Do not love the world, nor the things that are in the world; for all that is in the world is the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and pride.* <note>original: "nolito mundum diligere..." - 1 John 2:15-16.</note> And hence it is that the world has not known the children of God, because the children of God have not known the world, which indeed is entirely set in wickedness. Nevertheless, it is the will of God that hidden things be made manifest. And God promised through his Prophet that in the last days, before the end of the world’s cycle, he would pour out his holy Spirit upon all flesh. And the Royal Psalmist <note>King David, traditional author of the Psalms.</note> foretold that God would give the sons of men, who hope under the cover of his wings, to drink from the torrent of his pleasure; for with Him is the fountain of life, and in His light we shall see light.

<margin>
2 Cor. 1. 4.
</margin>
But to return to the inhabitants of that citadel of Wisdom built upon the mountain of reason: if it is granted to them by the holy Spirit of discipline to know all things—since it is His role to teach all things (whence the Apostle also says: *In the grace of God, which is given to you in Jesus Christ, you are made rich in him in all things, in every word, and in all knowledge*)—then it follows that those inhabitants of the house of Wisdom are those alone, and none besides them, who, like Solomon, possess science and knowledge in true <term>Magic</term> <note>The study of the hidden harmonies of nature and the divine.</note>, in true <term>Kabbalah</term> <note>The mystical interpretation of the Bible and the names of God.</note>, and in true <term>Chemistry</term> <note>original: "Chymia." For Fludd, this refers to Alchemy: the spiritual and physical art of purifying matter and the soul.</note>. We have previously spoken many weighty and relevant words regarding these arts; and such appears to be that praiseworthy <term>Brotherhood of the Rosy Cross</term>, so much talked about in the world in times past. Because they perceive that worldly people love worldly things more than divine ones, and hold the servants of the Lord in hatred and derision in this age as in previous ones, they therefore (as it seems to me) do not wish to appear to the world before the appointed time. But how unjust it is for Christians in this world not only to reject the divine gifts once offered by those brothers, but even to mock them, to hold them for Magicians and "little brothers of Acheron" <note>original: "fraterculis Acharontis." Acheron is a river in the underworld; this was a derogatory term implying the brothers were hell-dwellers or diabolical sorcerers.</note>, and to curse them with the greatest malice—I leave this to you, the readers, to judge, you who are occupied in the higher depths of the human mystery.

But far be it that all worldly people should fall into that most wicked and diabolical opinion toward their truly Christian brothers; and especially let that vice be far from religious men, lest they themselves pursue those brothers in Jesus Christ with calumnies and insults:

<margin>
Matt. 5. 23.
Matt. 7. 1.
Col. 1. 23.
</margin>
> Those, I say, who many times read and re-read these words of Christ: *Everyone who is angry with his brother shall be liable to judgment: whoever says "you fool," shall be liable to the hell of fire, etc.* And elsewhere: *Do not judge, and you will not be judged; do not condemn, and you will not be condemned; for with the judgment you judge, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you.*

Therefore, Brother Marin Mersenne seems to be the least of such [who follow these words], if we were to give any credit to this context of his. "See," he says, "that you do not incur the offense of the brotherhood, etc." But I fear lest he himself be wavering in this opinion of his, since it is his way in his volume now to affirm, now to deny. For how many times he himself has sinned against this precept published by him, can be hidden from no one of sound mind. And yet he received these things from our Savior:

<margin>
Matt. 7. 3. & 5.
</margin>

Here, I say, he warns us lest we run into the "offense of the brothers," and yet he himself everywhere offends his brothers with calumnies and insults, judges severely and treats them maliciously, and condemns them with unheard-of punishment. But let us hear what his judgment is regarding that divine and elect seed among men, which they call the <term>Brotherhood of the Rosy Cross</term>.

# Concerning the Highest Good, etc.

### From Column 1452 of Mersenne.
<note>Marin Mersenne (1588–1648) was a French polymath and priest who was a fierce critic of magic and the Rosicrucians.</note>

I truly desire that judges and princes be seriously warned not to permit these portents and monsters of erroneous opinions to spread within their domains. They should utterly eliminate those hellish "little brothers" <note>original: "Acheronteos... fraterculos" — Mersenne uses the diminutive "little brothers" as an insult and "Acheronteos" to link them to Acheron, a river in the Greek underworld.</note> of the Rose Cross, who at almost every Frankfurt fair <note>The Frankfurt Book Fair was the center of European publishing; Mersenne is complaining about the volume of Rosicrucian pamphlets printed there.</note> introduce into the Christian world booklets smelling of impiety, issued from their cave and by a still-unknown, illegitimate Father. For the things they announce are blasphemous, and they betray themselves all too much as heretics and sorcerers—or at least as those who steal many things from the writings of sorcerers, etc.

### The Response.

Two reasons move and incite me to descend into the cause of these fortunate men in this place, against the false accusations of Mersenne. The first is because, in a certain treatise of mine, I defended that Brotherhood to the best of my ability against the slanderous aspersions of a certain individual. The second is because we consider it the highest duty of a true Christian and an honest man to resist the enemies and adversaries of truth and Divine Wisdom itself, and to drive back and repel their most wicked injuries; for it is the duty of such a man to venerate Divine Wisdom and its children with the greatest reverence and to pursue them with faithful and sincere love. But to deal with this matter using the same method we applied to that Brotherhood and the three preceding main pillars of Wisdom—namely Magic, Kabbalah, and Alchemy <note>original: "Magia, Cabala, atq; Chymia"</note>—we say that:

**The Brotherhood of the Rose Cross is either:**

| **True & Essential** | **Adulterated & Spurious** |
| :--- | :--- |
| Which is correctly engaged in the truth of: | Others of this sect falsely put on such a name, or are led astray, being: |

Thus, by these impieties of theirs, they contaminate true Wisdom and its sincere followers with perverse opinions and render them damnable in the eyes of the world.

If Mr. Mersenne understands the matter in this way, we certainly pronounce him innocent in this regard. Nevertheless, he is to be condemned for the fact that, in his judgment, he always confuses truth with falsehood and takes the part for the whole—or rather, the shadow for the true subject, or the truth for a fiction.

To this objection I respond: they are indeed enriched with heavenly riches, and yet to the world they are as if poor and unknown. Nor is it a wonder, since those who are rich in the Spirit despise the world and its pompous riches, according to that saying of the Evangelist: *do not love the world, nor the things that are in the world, for all that is in the world is the concupiscence of the flesh, the concupiscence of the eyes, and pride.* <note>original: "nolito mundum diligere... concupiscentia carnis... & superbia." And God promised through His Prophet that in the last days, before the end of the world, He would pour out His Holy Spirit upon all flesh. <note>A reference to the prophecy in Joel 2:28.</note> And the Royal Psalmist foresaw that God would give the children of men, who hope under the shadow of His wings, to drink from the torrent of His pleasure; for with Him is the fountain of life, and in His light we shall see light.

Of such a kind appears to be that praiseworthy Brotherhood of the Rosy Cross, so much discussed by the world in times past. Because they perceive that wordly men love worldly things more than divine ones, and hold the servants of the Lord in hatred and derision in this age as in previous ones, they therefore (as it seems to me) refuse to appear to the world before the appointed time. But how unjust it is for Christians in this world not only to reject the divine gifts once offered by these brothers, but even to mock them, to consider them "little brothers from hell," <note>original: "fraterculis Achäronteis" — Mersenne used this diminutive to mock the brothers and link them to Acheron, a river in the Greek underworld.</note> and to curse them with the greatest malice—I leave this for you, the readers, to judge, you who are occupied in the higher depths of the human mystery.

# On the Highest Good, etc.

### From Column 1452 of Mersenne.

*I truly desire that judges and princes be seriously warned not to permit these portents and monsters of erroneous opinions to run riot in their domains. They should utterly eliminate those underworld <note>original: "Acheronteos," referring to Acheron, a river in the Greek underworld; Mersenne is calling them hellish.</note> brothers of the Rose Cross, who, at almost every Frankfurt fair <note>The Frankfurt Book Fair was then, as now, the primary marketplace for new and controversial publications.</note>, introduce booklets smelling of impiety into the Christian world, along with their cave and their yet unknown bastard Father <note>original: "spurio Patre." A mocking reference to the mysterious founder of the order, Christian Rosenkreuz.</note>. For what they announce is blasphemous, and they reveal themselves all too clearly as heretics and magicians—or at least as those who steal many things from the writings of magicians, and so forth.*

->Response.<-

Two reasons move and incite me to descend into the cause of these blessed men in this place against the false accusations of Mersenne. The first of these is because, in a certain treatise of mine, I defended that Brotherhood to the best of my ability against the slanderous aspersions of a certain individual. The second is because we consider it the highest duty of a true Christian and an upright man to resist the enemies and adversaries of truth itself and of divine Wisdom, and to beat back and repel their most wicked injuries; for it is the duty of such a man to venerate divine Wisdom and its children with the greatest reverence and to follow them with faithful and sincere love. But so that we may deal with this Brotherhood in the same method as we did with the preceding three principal columns of Wisdom—namely <term>Magic</term><note>Here meaning "Natural Magic," the study of the hidden powers within nature.</note>, <term>Kabbalah</term><note>A form of Jewish mysticism adapted by Renaissance scholars to explore the divine structure of the universe.</note>, and <term>Alchemy</term>—we say that:

The Brotherhood of the Rose Cross is either:

1. **True and essential**, which is rightly engaged in true:
    * Magic or Wisdom.
    * Kabbalah.
    * Alchemy.
2. **Adulterated and bastardized**, and others of this sect falsely take up such a name, either driven by:
    * Avarice, or being in want, whereby they deceive the common people.
    * Pride, so that they may seem to be what they are not in reality.
    * Malice, so that by leading a wicked life they bring a most evil reputation upon the true Brotherhood.

As for that bastardized and falsely assumed name of the Brotherhood, we leave those distinguished scoundrels of this sect, who are worthy of the harshest punishment, to those whose duty it is to judge their deceits and frauds. For such deceivers are found everywhere and frequent almost every region, daily deceiving worldly people who gape after gold, riches, and the mysteries of the sciences. They do this either through their superstitious Magic, or their imaginary Astrology, or the false and sophisticated recipes of their bastardized Chemistry, or the follies of their lying Kabbalah. Thus, by these impieties of theirs, they contaminate true Wisdom and its sincere followers with perverse opinions and render them damnable in the eyes of the world.

If Mersenne understands it to be these men he speaks of, we certainly pronounce him innocent in this regard. Nevertheless, he is to be condemned in this: that in his judgment he always confuses truth with falsehood and takes the whole for the part—or rather, the shadow for the true subject, or the truth for a fiction.

Furthermore, men of the true sect, who are uplifted toward God, are to be praised with the highest honors rather than condemned with such vehemence by the ignorant. But since they are judged and condemned by Brother Mersenne without the cause being known at all, and are held to be "little brothers of the underworld," it must first be seriously considered what their Palace or Castle might be, and what house it is, of which so...

<meta>This page continues Robert Fludd’s point-by-point rebuttal of Marin Mersenne. # Treatise

...mention was made in their *Fama* <note>original: "Fama"; referring to the *Fama Fraternitatis*, the first Rosicrucian manifesto published in 1614.</note>, then later who and what sort of people its inhabitants are, and why among other names they are called "Brothers" in the first place, and consequently why they are "of the Rosy Cross," and finally, the testimony drawn from them must be brought forth into the public view. From this, we may be able to judge whether such men are worthily or deservedly proclaimed and trumpeted abroad by Marin Mersenne as portents and monsters of erroneous opinions and "Acherontic Little Brothers" <note>original: "Acheronteis Fraterculis"; a derogatory term implying they are brothers from the underworld or hell.</note> or not. What my opinion is concerning these doubts, I will briefly show you here.

To the first point, therefore, we say that the palace or monastery of this Fraternity—as we can gather from their own words—is that of which the Holy Scripture speaks thus: *Let us ascend to the rational mountain, and let us build the house of Wisdom.* We recognize the foundation of this mountain to be the *cornerstone, which was cut out of the mountain without hands (as the Prophet witnesses) and became a great mountain filling the whole earth after it had broken the feet of the statue.* <note>A reference to the Book of Daniel 2:34-35; Fludd interprets the stone as Christ and the "mountain" as a spiritual kingdom.</note> *Hence the Prophet says: The house of God is great, O Israel, and vast is the place of his possession*, that is, his mountain, which in truth is that true mountain Horeb, or that Spiritual Zion so often repeated in Holy Scripture. And this stone is the same rock, that true house intended by the Evangelist when he asserts that *the wise man built his house and dug deep and placed its foundation upon the rock* etc. But that rock is Christ, upon whom the Spiritual house and the holy Priesthood are built. Truly, although we are commanded to build a house upon this rocky mountain, it is nevertheless evident that this is not a human work—as foolish Alchemists <term>Alchemists: Fludd distinguishes between "foolish" alchemists seeking physical gold and "spiritual" alchemists seeking divine transformation.</term> or Sophistic Mages <note>original: "Magi Sophistici"; refers to those who practice magic through trickery or false logic rather than divine wisdom.</note> think—but a divine one. Whence it is most certain that unless Wisdom herself is present for such a work, acting as the primary agent both in the artist and in the subject of the work, the effort of human art will provide nothing; which the sacred text also seems to affirm in these express words of Psalm 127:1: *Unless the Lord builds the house, they labor in vain who build it* etc. One adapts and disposes the house given and signified by God with a learned and expert hand, and then afterward God acts toward its perfection; not otherwise than we see a male acting upon a receptive female to procreate a third thing through adaptation and arrangement—namely, the offspring—which the human craftsman does not build, but rather the divine Spirit lurking in the seed.

Hence the Apostle says: *We beseech you, brothers, that you abound more and more, and that you strive to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands as we commanded you* etc. And in what follows, he rebukes the idle with these words: *That you may desire nothing of anyone.* Psalm 127 [128], verse 1, David says: *Blessed are they who walk in the ways of the Lord, for they shall eat the labors of their hands:* and yet the hands of the craftsman do nothing (as I said) except by arranging and separating superfluities, and then the Spirit acts by itself toward the furnace <note>original: "clybanum"; literally an oven or furnace, here used metaphorically for the alchemical or spiritual process of refinement.</note> of perfection and toward the celestial arrangement of that royal palace. *A HOUSE* (says the Apostle) *not made with hands, or a Spiritual body, we have eternal in the heavens*, that is, the house of Wisdom built upon the rational mountain or Spiritual rock.

But Saint Paul also expressed this very well in these words: *I have planted (he said), Apollos watered, but God gave the increase. Therefore, neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but He who gives the increase, namely God; for we are God's helpers, it is God's husbandry; according to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise architect I have laid the foundation, but another builds upon it.*

*Let every man see how he builds upon it; for no one can lay any other foundation than that which is laid, which is Christ alone. But if anyone builds upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble, every man's work shall be made manifest, for the day of the Lord shall declare it, because it shall be revealed in fire; and the fire shall prove what sort every man's work is. If his work which he built remains, he shall receive a reward; if his work burns, he shall suffer loss.* Thus far the Apostle, etc.

# Concerning the Highest Good, etc.

<margin>Romans 9:33. 1 Peter 2:6. Isaiah 28:16. Jeremiah 22. Proverbs 14.</margin>
And from this it follows that in many places of Scripture he is called both a **rock of offense and a stumbling block** <note>original: "petra offensionis & scandali"</note>—namely, to adulterous Christians—as well as a **tested, precious cornerstone** set in a foundation for all who have believed in him, through which they shall not be put to shame. Therefore, just as he is a stone of stumbling, so the Prophet speaks of the house poorly founded upon him: *Woe to him who builds his house by injustice and his upper rooms by lack of justice.* And Solomon says: *The house of the wicked shall be destroyed.*

<margin>Proverbs 12. Matthew 7:24.</margin>
But as he is a **precious, tested cornerstone**, so upon this rock the true builders construct the **house of Wisdom**. I speak of the **house of the righteous**, which according to the Wise Man’s sentiment shall endure forever, inasmuch as it can be shaken neither by winds, nor by rain, nor by any flood whatsoever (as St. Matthew witnesses).

<margin>Psalm 5:7. Psalm 26:8. Psalm 84:10.</margin>
Of this House, the royal Psalmist <note>Referring to King David, traditionally credited with the Psalms.</note> sang:
> I will enter your house in the multitude of your mercy; I have loved the beauty of your house, and the place where your glory dwells. I have chosen to be an outcast in the house of my God, rather than to dwell in the tents of sinners, etc.

<margin>2 Samuel 7. 1 Chronicles 28.</margin>
By this speech, the King did not mean a Temple constructed by mere human skill, since according to the testimony of Scripture, the Lord did not dwell in a House from the Israelites' departure from Egypt until the time of Solomon, but held his dwelling in a tent. Furthermore, Jehovah, speaking to David himself, says: *You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood, etc.* By these words, he means a material temple; for the sacred Text witnesses that David possessed a description of the material Temple spiritually described for him by the **Finger of God**. From this, he also seems to argue that he had seen and been an architect in the structure of the house founded upon the **rational mountain** <note>Fludd uses "rational" here to mean the intellectual or spiritual realm of the soul.</note>; for it was according to this exemplar that not only the Tabernacle of the Covenant and the Temple of Solomon were formed, but also man himself, who is therefore called the **temple of the Holy Spirit**.

<margin>John 7:40. Revelation 3. Wisdom 16:5. Exodus 16:5. Matthew 4. Job 28:5.</margin>
Finally, we conclude that the unique construction of this house, with the help of a true brother, is the manifestation of the hidden; that is, the revelation of the **Spiritual Rock** or **mystic Wisdom** from the Patriarch's stone (which he calls the House of God). This is the construction of the Spiritual House or palace upon the rational mountain, and we call this stone the **mystic Fortress of Bethlehem**, of which the Evangelist speaks thus: *Christ was of the Fortress of Bethlehem.* This was where David was from, which can be very easily gathered from the Etymology: for <term>Bethlehem</term> (בית-לחם) denotes the **house of bread** and the **house of War**. But Manna was the hidden bread and the bread or food of Angels, the bread from heaven, and the **Word**, by which every man can live without the bread of the common people—as Christ teaches us in the Scriptures. From this it follows that Bethlehem is essentially the same as <term>Bethel</term> (בית-אל), which denotes the **House of God**, according to that saying of Jacob: *and this stone shall be called the House of God.* Therefore, if it is the House of God and the temple of Christ, the mystery of this thing is best described for us by that man of patience <note>Refers to Job.</note>, who speaks thus: *There is a land from which Bread arose, and in its place it was overturned by fire; its stones are the place of Sapphires, and its clods are gold; the bird has not known the path, etc. He puts his hand to the flint and overturns the mountains by their roots, etc.*

From these words, he designates not only the earthly substance of this House, but also the riches and the fiery light within it, and thereafter its virtue and power. Hence, because of its immense strength, Bethlehem is interpreted another way: as the **Fortress** from which Christ went forth, the **house of war**. For this reason, even by **Hermes** <note>Hermes Trismegistus, the legendary founder of alchemy.</note>—the true and divine Alchemist (not the one of the spurious alchemists)—that **Spiritual Stone** is called the **glory of the whole world**, by means of which all obscurity shall flee from you, and the **strong fortitude of all fortitude**. Because it overcomes every subtle thing and penetrates every solid thing. *Thus the world was created.* These are his words.

# Treatise

And thus you have, from the teachings of both Job and Hermes <note>Referring to Hermes Trismegistus, the legendary Egyptian sage and purported author of the Hermetic corpus, often cited by alchemists.</note>, a description not only of the precious materials of this kind of house or palace, but also its virtue. You also have it described in the **Cabalistic** <note>A reference to Jewish mysticism (Kabbalah), which Fludd integrated into his Christian philosophy.</note> manner through the name of another city or citadel built on the summit of a cliff, namely **Bethulia** <note>original: "בתוליה Bethulia"</note>, which signifies "virgin of the Lord" or "the house bringing forth the Lord." For this reason, it seems to mean the same thing as **Bethlehem**, which is as if to say "the virgin land bringing forth the Savior." Hence, this single word contains within itself the entire sermon of the Prophet: *Let the earth be opened and bring forth a Savior.* <note>Isaiah 45:8. Fludd is using wordplay to link the "House of Bread" (Bethlehem) with the spiritual "House of the Virgin."</note>

For it must first be considered that names, both for men and for cities in the Sacred Scriptures, contain no small mystery within them. Thus, the name of the city was changed from **Luz** to **Bethel** <note>Genesis 28:19; Bethel means "House of God."</note> because of the wonderful effect of the stone, which Jacob called the house of God. Similarly, **Bethlehem** is named from the living bread <note>Bethlehem literally means "House of Bread" in Hebrew.</note> which must come out of it as if from a house or castle. **Bethulia** has a metaphorical respect to the **House of Wisdom** built upon the mountain of reason; indeed, this name seems to be attributed to that city in a symbolic way, namely because this citadel or city was most beautiful, founded upon a rock or mountain. So too was **Mount Horeb**, so called as if it were the "Mountain of God," and so with the others. Finally, the Prophet denotes the mystery of the name Bethlehem in these words: *Christ the Leader of Israel from Bethlehem, he shall give them up until the time wherein she that travaileth shall bring forth, and the remnant of his brethren shall be converted to the children of Israel.* <note>Micah 5:2–3.</note>

You have here, therefore, that house or palace of **Wisdom** built upon the mountain of reason. Now it remains for us to inquire what sort of men those "wise ones" are to whom access to that royal palace is granted. The Apostle <note>Referring to St. Peter.</note> clearly describes such happy men, as well as their spiritual dwelling, in this way: *Like living stones, be built up upon Christ the stone himself into a spiritual house: a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ, etc. But you are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a purchased people, that you may declare the virtues of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light; who in time past were not a people of God, but are now the people of God, etc.* <note>1 Peter 2:5, 9–10.</note> In these words, he perfectly describes not only the firmest base of the structure, but also the builders and the inhabitants.

<margin>4 Esdras 2.</margin> And these are the faithful of Christ who, according to the teaching of Esdras, stripping off the **mortal tunic** <note>A metaphor for the physical body or the corruptible nature of man.</note> and putting on the immortal, and confessing the name of God, are now crowned and receive palms. Wherefore a certain man illuminated by Wisdom says: *For in vain shall mortals labor who have entered a path other than that which the Apostle wills—namely, by laying aside the tabernacle. This path is not achieved by dying according to the opinion of the common people, but as Peter intends where he says, "as Christ taught me," namely when he was transfigured on the mountain. If this "laying aside" were not secret and hidden, the Apostle would not have said "as Jesus taught me," nor would the Supreme Truth <note>i.e., Jesus Christ.</note> have said "tell this to no one"; for according to the common way, dying in the common manner was known to all from the beginning of the world, etc.* So he says. By these words, he seems to prove the wonderful power of this people, given to them as a gift by Christ.

<margin>1 Kings 2:35.</margin> Similarly, of this kind was he of whom it is said: *I will build a faithful house for a faithful priest, and he shall walk before my Christ all his days.* Such, I say, are those of whom the Prophet means when he says: <margin>Isaiah 2:5.</margin> *House of Jacob, come and let us walk in the light of the Lord.* And of them also elsewhere: *As many as received this true light, to them he gave power to become the true sons of God, to those who believe in his name.*

From these things, therefore, you may perceive the state and condition of the inhabitants of this house. Now, however, it must be noted by what name they are called, since various titles are assigned to them in the holy pages—namely: **Sons of God**, **Elect of God**, a **Chosen Generation**, **Prophets**, and **Friends of God**. <margin>Wisdom 7.</margin> Solomon says, *Wisdom makes men to be prophets and friends of God.* Also: **Faithful**, **Just**, **Wise**, **Holy**, **Holy Nation**, **Holy Christians**, **True Catholics**, a **Purchased People**, the **True Seed of Abraham**, **Priests**, **Apostolic Brothers**, **Brothers of Christ**, the **Christian Fraternity** <note>A subtle reference to the Rosicrucian Brotherhood (*Fraternitas Rosae Crucis*).</note>, and many other names and additions, all of which it would be too long to review in this place and tedious to the reader. As for the final titles...

...custom, regarding why these are called the **seed of Abraham**, since such elect are chosen by God just as much from among the Gentiles as from the blood of the Jews, and finally why they are called brothers, why the **Apostolic and Christian Fraternity**, and consequently that of the <term>Rose Cross</term> <note>original: "Rosea Cruce." I have proposed to make a brief, yet well-considered discourse on this matter. <margin>Genesis 12</margin> First, it must be known that just as Christ was of the seed of Abraham, through whom blessing and salvation are promised to the world, so indeed all true Christians are to be called the seed of Abraham—not, as the Evangelist says, those born of blood and the pleasure of the flesh, but those born of God. *Christ said: Who is my mother, and who are my brothers? Whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother and sister and mother.* <note>Matthew 12:48–50.</note> But the Apostle clearly recognizes the succession of this kind of seed in these words: *Those who belong to Christ are the seed of Abraham, and are heirs according to the promise.* <note>Galatians 3:29.</note> For Saint Paul does not approve of those who are circumcised in the flesh, but in the heart; nor does he say the external Jew, but the internal one is chosen by God. Among such are also many of the Gentiles; for he does not say that only Jews are to be saved in the seed of Abraham, but all nations of the earth, as may be seen from the passage of Genesis mentioned before. The Gentiles are co-heirs, <margin>Galatians 3</margin> and members of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Gospel. But who will say: "What if this fraternity is not made of blood?" I answer according to the preceding sense of the Evangelist, that while one type of consanguinity and Fraternity is carnal and human, the other is **Spiritual and divine**. Thus it is said that the **children of God** <note>original: "filij Dei"</note> knew the daughters of men—that is, those elect of God from the line of Seth, with whom God walked, [mingled] with the daughters of the cursed line of Cain, of whom the Poets say, *You are a divine race, etc.* Therefore, the divine seed is not that carnal one, but is forged from pure fire and Spirit, through which worldly people are rendered children of God by election, according to the sense of Saint Peter: *You who were once not a people of God, are now the people of God.* <margin>1 Peter 2; Wisdom 12</margin> And <margin>Wisdom 12</margin> this seed is that **incorruptible Spirit** which God has enclosed in all things. Christ also seems to verify this in this series of words: *God is able to raise up children of Abraham from stones,* <margin>Matthew 3; Luke 3; 1 Corinthians 11; 1 Peter 2:4; Hebrews 3:6; Hebrews 5</margin> that is, new Christs and Christians, whose head is Jesus Christ (as the Apostle testifies): *The head of the man Christ is God,* and hence elsewhere: *We are the house of Christ, etc.* And again, Christ—who (according to the Prophet) is the light of Israel from Bethlehem (that is, from the **house of bread**) <note>Fludd uses the Hebrew etymology of Bethlehem, "Beit Lechem" (House of Bread), to link Christ to the "Living Bread" and the spiritual "House."</note>—speaks in me, is formed in you, and is powerful in you. <margin>2 Corinthians 13</margin> But *Christ is the cornerstone* to whom we, like **living stones**, <margin>1 Peter 2</margin> ought to be built up, derived from him as the Leader of Israel and the chief rock, who sends forth living waters from his perennial fountain.

From this it follows that insofar as we are **living stones**, we are the seed of Abraham; and insofar as we are the seed of Abraham, we are the true brothers of Christ and internal Israelites; and insofar as we are internal Israelites, we are the **temple of God**. For insofar as we are the divine seed, we are living stones, and insofar as we are living stones cut from the single rock which is Christ, we are made one with Christ through this same faith—namely, his members, as he who (according to the Apostle) *is one body having many members, and consequently co-heirs with him of the heavenly kingdom.* <margin>1 Corinthians 12; Galatians 3</margin> From this it is certain that the unique thing within us, by which we are called living stones, is that truth alone within us through which we are confirmed by faith to be the children of God. Whatever else exists in the "dark mass" of man is a fiction and a false image, and cannot truly be called virtue or truth. Therefore, it will scarcely—not even scarcely—endure the <term>trial of fire</term> <note>A reference to the alchemical and biblical "purgation" where only truth survives the heat of judgment.</note> on the day of judgment, being like a <term>chimerical smoke</term> <note>original: "fumus Chymereus." A play on "chimera" and "chemical," referring to the false, smoky operations of common alchemy compared to the "gold" of spiritual truth.</note> compared to that gold of God which must be bought from Christ. That truth alone, I say, is perfect for every test of fire; indeed, it is purged by the power of fire, it rejoices, and is rendered more glorious, as can be seen more clearly from the words of the Apostle. <margin>1 Corinthians 3:13–15</margin> Here, therefore, it must first be noticed who are the children of Abraham or those Israelites: they are not carnal, but spiritual, namely **living stones**, who are said by the Evangelist to be born not of carnal union, but of God; and second, that it is possible for such children of Abraham to be raised even from stones.

-># Treatise<-

By the testimony of the holy things, we have declared that the Brotherhood of the elect is joined to the Apostolic and Christian titles; why then should it not also be joined to this title of the **Rosy Cross**? Indeed, within the Roman religion, we have an order dedicated to the Holy Cross. Is it therefore a matter of such unworthiness to add this supplement of the **Rosy Cross** to the Apostolic Brotherhood and to the true elect and brothers of God? Or will anyone believe that the addition of the **Rosy Cross** carries no significance pertaining to a matter of such great importance? On the contrary, I shall show that the addition of the **Rosy Cross** opens and uncovers the entire mystery of the brotherhood of the faithful, although to the ignorant it plainly seems to sound like nothing or very little to the purpose. 

It is not indeed without reason that on English sails, and also on the breasts of Christian Champions in the war against the Saracens and Turks, they carried the characters of a rosy and red cross. Therefore, I think it is worth the effort to explain the mystery of the cross in this place especially, so that we may better explain the certain reason for adding such a name to the Brotherhood. 

It must be known, therefore, that the Holy Scripture has proposed a double cross to us—no differently than it proposes a double law, a double sense of the Holy Bible, and a double wisdom—namely, the external and the internal. Every external thing is a veil <note>original: "obuelamen," a covering or disguise.</note> for its internal counterpart. Thus, under the external law, the internal is hidden like a kernel in a shell; likewise, in the sacred writing, the spirit is hidden by the letter, and Divine and mystical Wisdom is hidden within that confused worldly wisdom, which is merely of men. 

For after **Adam** had tasted of the tree of knowledge of good and evil, confusion immediately arose, and the lucid truth was so veiled by the darkness of fiction that error immediately crept into the world. And so, in place of pure and simple unity, a confusion of unities arose—namely, that **binary** number <note>The "binary" (two) represents duality and division, contrasting with the "monad" or divine unity.</note>, a two-headed monster, as it were, looking as much toward evil as toward good. And from here was born the connection of internal and external, the mixture of vice and virtue, the staining of mystical wisdom with human wisdom, and the hiding of light in darkness. To reduce all these things into one: it is the veiling of the spirit under the letter. But what need is there for more words? To speak briefly, the same proportion that existed between worldly or human wisdom and that which is divine, exists between the corporeal and external cross and that which is spiritual.

<margin>
1 Cor. 3.
1 Cor. 1.
James 3.

<meta>This page continues Robert Fludd’s explanation of the "Rosy Cross," shifting from the botanical allegories of the previous page to the geometric and alchemical requirements for finding the "mystical blood" at the center of all things. Fludd explains that spiritual discovery requires deep "digging" into the essence of matter.</meta>

### Treatise

However, for a better method of operation, so that one may arrive at the **Rosy blood of the cross** <note>original: "Roseum crucis sanguinem." This refers to the vital, spiritual essence or "tincture" that Fludd believes is hidden within the heart of nature.</note> lying hidden in the center of the subject, it must be understood that we can expend no small amount of work and labor in this business. For it is not to be dealt with superficially; rather, one must dig, knock, and search even to the very center of the earth, or our work will be for naught. For a certain true Philosopher, most skilled in essential Chemistry, says that all bodies are enclosed by three dimensions: namely, manifest **height**, hidden **depth**, and intermediate **width**. Indeed, there is no transition from one extreme to another except through the middle. This means that the manifest form of any body cannot become known to us in its hidden state except through the **corruption** <note>In alchemy, "corruption" is the necessary first step of breaking down a substance so that it can be transformed into something higher.</note> of the manifest, so that we may arrive at the revelation of the hidden.

The truth of this matter is drawn out through the depth of a geometric cube: for its length, when drawn into itself, indicates its width, which again, when multiplied by the length, will manifest its depth. In a similar respect, Alchemists are accustomed to convert manifest forms into hidden ones by corrupting the **specific form** <note>The outward, identifying characteristics of a thing.</note> and producing a more **general form** <note>The underlying, universal essence or "prime matter."</note>. And all of this is done by the conversion or relation of the elements from the composite into the compounded, and by the transmutation of the impure into the pure. This, therefore, is the work of true and divine **Alchemy**, by means of which an entrance is made into the paradise of pleasure for worldly men, so that we may gather that red rose with the Lilies of the valley and eat from the **tree of life**. Does not the Apostle teach us this same way in these words:

<margin>Ephesians 3:18.</margin>
> *That you may be able to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth; and to know the love of Christ which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.*

By these words, he seems to denote that the knowing artist and the truly **God-taught** <term>Theodidactus: One who is taught directly by God rather than by human instruction.</term> ought to dig deeply into the earth and work in all the subtlety of the triple dimension, so that he may find the true **cornerstone** which God has laid in the base or foundation of the earth. By this, he may know the surpassing love of the knowledge of Christ and be filled with all the fullness of God, etc. We conclude, therefore, that this **Rosy Cross**, or that mystical blood of the cross (of which a certain divine Poet says: *Sacred form, whose garment shines with venerable beauty*), is to be sought out even unto blood by strenuous knocking and by patiently expecting and imploring the divine blessing, according to that instruction of the Apostle:

<margin>Hebrews 12:4.</margin>
> *You have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin, etc.*

By which he argues in a hidden way that this "sin" is everything **heterogeneous** <note>In this context, "heterogeneous" refers to any impure or foreign material that does not belong to the "pure truth."</note>—everything that is not of the pure truth, which is Jesus Christ. It must be laid aside and rejected with all diligence, as much from the human or animal **stone** as from any other, so that the truth may shine forth to the artist and true brother in its Rosy and bloody radiance. In that divine light, he may see the light and finally taste happily of the fruit of his labors, according to that saying of the Apostle concerning the wise Farmer:

> *The hardworking Farmer must be the first to receive the fruits of his labor.*

Therefore, when these things are well weighed, it will be clear how **parabolic** and **mystical** is this blood of the cross and the cross of Christ, which every true Christian ought to investigate with the greatest effort, until he finds that most ruddy Rose or that most precious blood of the cross fixed and permanent there. Thus, at last, he may deservedly be called a **brother of the Rosy Cross** and be rewarded by the true fraternity, verifying the axiom of the royal Psalmist:

<margin>Psalm 133:1.</margin>
> *How good and how pleasant it is for brothers to dwell together in unity.*

Finally, someone will no doubt say: "How is it that you presume to understand the mind of that brotherhood so well, or in what way are you so instructed in their secrets that you can gather not only their religion and condition, but even the reason why they are called brothers of the Rosy Cross? What? Are you one of these little brothers of the Rosy Cross yourself?"

To this last question, I say that I have by no means ever deserved so much from God...

->Venerable Man & Honored Lord<-

*Since this will be the first year of your birth <note>Likely referring to a spiritual "rebirth" or the beginning of the candidate's initiation.</note>, we pray to God Most High for a most happy entrance and exit for your life; and because you have stood forth until now as a constant searcher of **sacred philosophy** with a good soul, bravo! proceed, and fear God: for in this way you shall prepare for yourself the path to the heavens and the truest knowledge. He who adds knowledge, also adds sorrow <note>original: "Qui scientiam addit, addit & dolore."
